invariants.rationale: Engine context should be non-null for a meaningful bulk insert operation.
A valid (non-null) instant time is required for the insertion operation.
The list of records cannot be null in a bulkInsert operation, as it forms the data payload.
If the records list is empty, its size should be zero or positive (true for any List, but specifically highlights expectation for software contracts).
Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> should not be null, even if it wraps an empty value, for API consistency.
